name: Standing Barbell Curl
grip: Supinated underhand, approximately shoulder width, with wrists aligned with the forearms.
description: Curl a straight bar upward by bending the elbows while standing with the upper arms close to the torso.
setup: Hold a straight bar in front of the thighs with an underhand grip.
Stand evenly on both feet, soften the knees and brace the torso.
instructions: Bend the elbows to raise the bar without leaning backward.
Keep the upper arms close to the sides as the bar approaches the lower chest.
Stop before the shoulders roll forward or the elbows need to swing.
Lower slowly toward extended elbows without snapping them straight.
commonMistakes: Swinging the hips or leaning backward.
Bending the wrists to finish the curl.

logging.example: A 20 kg bar plus two 15 kg plates: record 50 kg total.
